source.name: FC Cincinnati: 'FC Cincinnati unveil The Orange and Blue Legacy Kit'
source.quote: complemented by the secondary sponsor, Kroger, located on the wearer's right sleeve
source.note: Kroger has been the club's sleeve partner since at least the 2023 River Kit, where the club's Kit Vault says Kroger 'returned' as sleeve partner. The Cincinnati Business Courier reported the original sleeve-patch deal on 2021-09-28, but that page is paywalled and could not be opened by script. Deal start, end and value unknown.
